key_idea: Center each word; keep a counter of rows with odd blank count and alternate which side gets the extra blank.
sketch: For each word compute blanks b=c-len. If b is even, pad b/2 on each side. Otherwise increment a counter of unbalanced rows: on odd-numbered such rows left=b/2 (l<r), on even-numbered ones left=b/2+1. O(r*c). Pitfall: the alternation counts only the rows that cannot be centered, not all rows.
